sermon.title: Hypocrisy — August 7, 2022
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: A hypocrite, by Jesus’ definition, claims to follow God and love neighbor but doesn’t. Jesus named hypocrisy in alms, prayer, fasting, judging, men’s laws, greed and neglect of justice, mercy and faithfulness. God’s answer is wisdom from above, given to all who ask.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Spoken “Hosea 6 8” corrected to Micah 6:8; “Psalms 104” to Psalm 100.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore submit to God. Resist the devil and he will flee from you. Draw near to God and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded. Lament and mourn and weep! Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom. Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and He will lift you up.

Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise. Be thankful to Him, and bless His name. For the LORD is good; His mercy is everlasting, And His truth endures to all generations.

chunks.short_answer: Wisdom from above—pure, peaceable, without partiality or hypocrisy—given liberally to all who ask.

Easy to being treated entreated or easy to cooperate with right things they they’re not in conflict with doing with joining a group and doing things together. Full of mercy and good fruits there’s that. Micah 6:8 again what does the Lord require of thee to do what justly love what mercy and walk what humbly and obedience with your God.

Not a little bit he’ll give you a little time don’t get me wrong because you’ve got to be able to handle it but he’s ready to give you. Amen. Very powerful. What we got in America today. Is a lack of respect. A lack of value. A lack to stand up.

but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

chunks.section_question: What does loving your neighbor look like?
chunks.short_answer: A pizza man rescuing children from a fire and a grandfather who died saving his grandson.
chunks.text:
For my neighbor. Because I would want him standing up for me. If I was in his situation. Are you hearing me. Hallelujah. Last week in the news. A pizza man was delivering pizza. And as he was going. To the house to deliver he saw a fire and another house. And he saw three kids in the upstairs window. That pizza man dropped his pizza boxes. Went into that fiery house. And save those three kids. Because he wanted to help his neighbor.

Like he would wanted to be helped if he was there. He brought these three kids to the smoke and the fire and outside and when they got outside the kid says we got another. Brother back in there he’s in this room. And this guy got up and went back into that fiery house. Found that kid. And brought him out. That’s exercising love your neighbor as yourself that’s exercising doing under others as you’d have them do unto you they were in a crisis and he rescued them and he got so. I don’t forget what the word is but overtaken by the smoke and the gas that he just collapsed on the ground the paramedics arrived.

And the first words out of his mouth when they were tending him. Was are the kids okay. Are the kids safe. He wasn’t worried about himself. Another story in the news. The family went fishing in Michigan. Has all these great lakes. A father a grandfather. Nine-year-old and a three-year-old. The three-year-old somehow. Got tossed out of the boat. The dad immediately jumped in but went the wrong direction.

Now these great lakes are like the ocean I don’t know if you know that it’s not like Elsinore lake it’s got waves and you know it’s got cairns it’s yeah. And so the dad got drifted away from the three-year-old. The grandfather dives in. To save his grandson. 71 years old. And he didn’t think about himself. He was exercising the principle. Do unto others as you have them do unto you. The nine-year-old boy had enough sense. To grab his dad’s phone and call 9-1-1. And when they got there.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And you will seek Me and find Me, when you search for Me with all your heart.

faqs.question: What is the Greek meaning of hypocrite?
Can people live by their own moral standard?
faqs.answer: He says it isn’t God’s and isn’t common sense.

faqs.question: Did he struggle to pray aloud?
faqs.answer: Yes, as a bashful young Christian.

faqs.question: Did the thief on the cross do works?
faqs.answer: He believed and confessed his sin.

faqs.question: What is his online group?
faqs.answer: A group called Truth that grew to 1,800.

faqs.question: Which word did Jesus use most?
Why was he seen leaving bars?
faqs.answer: He went in to reach people, and was gossiped about.

faqs.question: Does God show partiality?
faqs.answer: No—male or female, rich or poor, any race.

faqs.question: Is wisdom only for one party?
faqs.answer: No; He gives to all liberally.
